description: Source file implementing Xen domain control functions for Zephyr OS, including domain management, vCPU configuration, memory mapping, and device assignment.

methods.name: do_domctl
methods.description: Performs a hypercall to execute a domain control operation, setting interface version before call.

methods.name: xen_domctl_scheduler_op
methods.description: Performs a scheduler operation on a specified domain.

methods.name: xen_domctl_pausedomain
methods.description: Pauses a specified domain.

methods.name: xen_domctl_unpausedomain
methods.description: Unpauses a specified domain.

methods.name: xen_domctl_resumedomain
methods.description: Resumes a paused domain.

methods.name: xen_domctl_getvcpucontext
methods.description: Retrieves vCPU context for a domain.

methods.name: xen_domctl_setvcpucontext
methods.description: Sets vCPU context for a domain.

methods.name: xen_domctl_getdomaininfo
methods.description: Gets information about a domain.

methods.name: xen_domctl_get_paging_mempool_size
methods.description: Retrieves the size of the paging memory pool for a domain.

methods.name: xen_domctl_set_paging_mempool_size
methods.description: Sets the size of the paging memory pool for a domain.

methods.name: xen_domctl_max_mem
methods.description: Sets maximum memory for a domain.

methods.name: xen_domctl_set_address_size
methods.description: Sets address size for a domain.

methods.name: xen_domctl_iomem_permission
methods.description: Sets I/O memory permissions for a domain.

methods.name: xen_domctl_memory_mapping
methods.description: Maps memory regions for a domain, handling large mappings with chunking.

methods.name: xen_domctl_assign_dt_device
methods.description: Assigns a device tree device to a domain.

methods.name: xen_domctl_bind_pt_irq
methods.description: Binds a physical IRQ to a domain.

methods.name: xen_domctl_max_vcpus
methods.description: Sets maximum vCPUs for a domain.

methods.name: xen_domctl_createdomain
methods.description: Creates a new domain with specified configuration.

methods.name: xen_domctl_destroydomain
methods.description: Destroys a specified domain.

methods.name: xen_domctl_cacheflush
methods.description: Flushes cache for a domain.
